title: Reaction Quotient vs Equilibrium Constant
body: For the reaction: CO(g) + H2O(g) <=> CO2(g) + H2(g), Kc = 5.0 at a certain temperature. At a particular moment, the concentrations are: [CO] = 0.2 mol/dm^3, [H2O] = 0.2 mol/dm^3, [CO2] = 0.3 mol/dm^3, [H2] = 0.3 mol/dm^3. Is the system at equilibrium? If not, in which direction will it shift?
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Chemical Equilibrium
